reviews.name: Anna K., UK
reviews.body: I was extremely nervous because of a bad dental experience in the past. The team took their time to explain everything and never rushed me. The treatment was completely painless, and for the first time I felt truly safe in a dental clinic.

reviews.name: Michael R., Germany
reviews.body: What impressed me most was the honesty. I was shown several treatment options with clear pros and cons, and there was no pressure to choose the most expensive one. Very transparent and professional approach!

reviews.name: Sofia L., Italy
reviews.body: I came in with acute pain and was treated the same day. The diagnosis was fast, the anesthesia was gentle, and the pain relief was immediate. Everything was explained clearly, even during an emergency situation.

faqs.question: Do you accept international patients?
faqs.answer: Yes — we frequently work with international clients and provide English-speaking support.

faqs.question: Is the clinic easy to reach by public transport?
faqs.answer: Our clinic is near public transport. Contact reception for directions before your visit.

faqs.question: Do you have parking?
faqs.answer: Yes, free on-site parking is available for our patients.

faqs.question: How early should I arrive for my appointment?
faqs.answer: Please contact reception to confirm your arrival time and any preparation needed for your visit.

faqs.question: Can I book an appointment online?
faqs.answer: Use the form below to prepare your appointment request, or call our reception to arrange your visit.

faqs.question: Do you offer emergency visits?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer same-day emergency appointments, subject to availability. Please call reception for urgent help.
